name: Yankee Kanojo to Kozukuri Gakuen Life ~Suki to ka Iuna! Buttobasu zo! Omae no Aka-chan Hoshikunacchimau Darou ga…~
original_name: ヤンキー彼女と子作り学園ライフ ～好きとか言うな！ぶっとばすぞ！お前の赤ちゃん欲しくなっちまうだろうが…っ～
source:
The protagonist was a weak guy, so when beautiful yankee Ayame rescued him he was smitten. 
 When he found out one day that she was may be forced into an arranged marriage, 
 he mustered the courage to tell her how he felt. Impressed by his moment of manliness she said, 
 "If you really like me you'll steal me!" It was the touching start of a vulnerable, awkward, schizophrenically emotional love life.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE112529.html]DLSite English[/url]]
